target='.....((((.(((.((....))((....)).))).(((.((....))((....)).))).(((.((....))((....)).))).(((.((....))((....)).))).)))).....'
n=119

def score(seq):
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(seq)
    ss,mfe=fc.mfe()
    return RNA.bp_distance(ss,target), ss

def rand_init():
    # structure-aware init
    pairs=[(5,113),(6,112),(7,111),(8,110),
    (10,33),(11,32),(12,31),(14,21),(15,20),(22,29),(23,28),
    (35,58),(36,57),(37,56),(39,46),(40,45),(47,54),(48,53),
    (60,83),(61,82),(62,81),(64,71),(65,70),(72,79),(73,78),
    (85,108),(86,107),(87,106),(89,96),(90,95),(97,104),(98,103)]
    seq=['A']*n
    comp={'G':'C','C':'G','A':'U','U':'A'}
    for (i,j) in pairs:
        b=random.choice(['G','C'])
        seq[i]=b; seq[j]=comp[b]
    return ''.join(seq)

def anneal(seq, steps=4000):
    seq=list(seq)
    cur,_=score(''.join(seq))
    T=2.0
    for step in range(steps):
        T=max(0.05, 2.0*(1-step/steps))
        # pick a paired position to mutate (and its partner)
        i=random.randint(0,n-1)
        # find partner

        for (a,b) in [(5,113),(6,112),(7,111),(8,110),
        (10,33),(11,32),(12,31),(14,21),(15,20),(22,29),(23,28),

        (85,108),(86,107),(87,106),(89,96),(90,95),(97,104),(98,103)]:

            if i==b: j=a; break
        old=seq[i]
        new=random.choice(['G','C','A','U'])
        if j is not None:
            comp={'G':'C','C':'G','A':'U','U':'A'}
            seq[i]=new; seq[j]=comp[new]
